Technology due diligence

A clearer transaction for everyone.

The Warrior Technology Condition Report focuses on the network, automation, AV, surveillance and supporting infrastructure—complementing the property’s broader inspection process.

01

Find issues before they become deal friction

Identify weak coverage, aging equipment, incomplete cabling, unsupported controls, security concerns and missing access information early.

02

Present the property more clearly

Documented systems give agents a factual way to explain what is installed, what works and where upgrades may add value.

03

Give the next owner a clean start

Plan credential transfers, ownership changes, system orientation and priority improvements before or immediately after closing.

How the relationship works

Fast answers without technical guesswork.

We work as the technology specialist beside the agent and property team, keeping the review focused, documented and useful to the transaction.

01

Define the transaction need

Pre-listing, buyer due diligence, system transfer or a targeted concern identified during the sale.

02

Inspect the connected systems

Review network performance, equipment, cabling, AV, automation, surveillance and visible documentation.

03

Issue the condition report

Summarize current condition, urgency, age-related risk and practical next steps in plain language.

04

Support the transfer

Help address priority items and establish the next owner’s access, orientation and ongoing service plan.
